divergences.what: Also gated the monk AC bonus and fast movement on unarmored, shieldless and light load
divergences.why: Both applied unconditionally; the checklist item this plan implements calls for verifying that gating

divergences.what: Corrected a premise in playerArmorSpeed.test.js: a monk in full plate no longer keeps fast movement
divergences.why: That test was written before the gating and asserted the old ungated behaviour

divergences.what: Flurry rows also render for the unarmed punch fallback when no weapon is equipped
divergences.why: An unarmed strike is a flurry weapon, so a barehanded monk would otherwise see no flurry at all

divergences.what: Added getInspireCourageBonus() alongside the helpers the step names
divergences.why: Inspire courage grants a level-scaled morale bonus its summary refers to but does not state

divergences.what: Added src/style/bardic_music.css for the performance list
divergences.why: The list needs its own layout; the step files omitted a stylesheet and inline styles would break the rem convention

divergences.what: Added favoredEnemyTypes and favoredEnemySubtypes to the Ranger block in classes.json
divergences.why: The SRD type and subtype lists were absent, and step 7's editor cannot offer a choice without them

divergences.what: Added three favored-enemy thunks and src/style/favored_enemy.css
divergences.why: The editor cannot persist without thunks, and its layout needs rem styling outside the component

divergences.what: Added an onSetCombatStyle thunk; the card reuses favored_enemy.css rather than adding a stylesheet
divergences.why: The card needs persistence, and its list and select layout are identical to the favored enemy editor
The granted power arrives as HTML paragraphs that need margin control, and inline styles cannot reach p tags

divergences.what: features_page now reads shortClassFeatures, not classFeatures, falling back when a class has no short form
divergences.why: Only the short entries carry the [N] markers the pills need; the long prose became the expanded body
The marker parser is real logic worth guarding, and a leading-marker-only rule is easy to regress

divergences.what: The cleric warning checks alignment-domain mismatch, not distance from a deity's alignment
divergences.why: The model stores no deity, so there is nothing to measure one step against

divergences.what: Added alignmentForbidden, alignmentRequiresNeutralAxis and alignmentDomains to classes.json
divergences.why: Barbarian, Bard and Druid alignment rules and the alignment-domain list were absent from the data
